hook.name: EveriseHook
hook.description: Collects a configurable sell fee (in ETH) on token-to-ETH swaps via afterSwapReturnsDelta, accumulates the ETH in a fee pool, then executes a nested buyback swap to purchase the project token and burn it via ITokenBurn.burn(). Burns are triggered automatically when feePool reaches a minimum threshold, with deferred retry on failure.
